tasks.title: Three-page quarterly report
tasks.prompt: Create a polished three-page quarterly report from inputs/report.json. Include a title page/summary, segment analysis, and Appendix Alpha. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: Invoice from structured data
tasks.prompt: Create a clear professional invoice from inputs/invoice.json. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: Branded business letter
tasks.prompt: Create a one-page formal business letter using inputs/letter.json. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: Completion certificate
tasks.prompt: Create a landscape completion certificate from inputs/certificate.json. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: Accessible PDF
tasks.prompt: Create a semantically structured accessible English document from inputs/notice.json with title, language, headings, and a PDF/UA claim. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: Existing PDF-template overlay
tasks.prompt: Inspect inputs/form-template.pdf and add the supplied record values without removing the template marker. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: 1,000 personalized statements
tasks.prompt: Generate one ordered PDF containing 1,000 distinct one-page statements described by inputs/job.json. The first id is ADB-VDP-0001 and the last is ADB-VDP-1000. Produce output/document.pdf and report truthful execution metrics in submission.json.

tasks.title: Repair overflowing content
tasks.prompt: Create a one-page notice from inputs/overflow.json. The supplied long identifier must remain complete and visible without clipping. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: Multilingual glyph coverage
tasks.prompt: Create a document containing every supplied translation with no missing glyphs. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: Archival PDF/A document
tasks.prompt: Create an archival document from inputs/archive.json with an explicit PDF/A claim and required metadata. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: Print-ready PDF/X document
tasks.prompt: Create a print-ready promotional sheet from inputs/print.json with an explicit PDF/X claim and output intent. Produce output/document.pdf.

tasks.title: Deterministic reproduction
tasks.prompt: Create the requested artifact twice from identical inputs in independent runs. Produce byte-identical output/document.pdf and output/document-rerun.pdf.

tasks.title: Variable data that changes pagination
tasks.prompt: Generate one ordered PDF for the 20 variable-length records described by inputs/job.json. Content length must naturally change pagination without truncation. Produce output/document.pdf.
